texts: General method for purification and quantification of the derivative
The crude peptide was dissolved in Acetic Acid/Acetonitrile/MQ water (4:2:4) and
purified by reversed-phase preparative HPLC (Waters Delta Prep 4000) on a column
comprising C18-silica gel. Elution was performed with an increasing gradient of MeCN in MQ
water comprising 0.1% TFA. Relevant fractions were analysed with UPLC. Fractions
containing the pure target peptide were pooled. The resulting solution was analyzed (UPLC,
LCMS) and the peptide derivative was quantified using a CAD specific HPLC detector
(Thermo-Fischer Vanquish HPLC-CAD). The product was dispensed into glass vials. The
vials were capped with Millipore glassfibre prefilters. Freeze-drying afforded the
trifluoroacetate salt of the derivative as a white solid.
